issues.description: The reference solution defines the Lecture constructor with package-private visibility (no access modifier) while the problem text and typical expectations imply a publicly accessible constructor for instantiating Lecture objects. This can confuse students about which visibility to use and may cause test code or external code (outside the package) to be unable to instantiate Lecture if a public constructor was expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor explicitly public in both the template instructions and the solution (change 'Lecture(...)' to 'public Lecture(...)') so students clearly implement a public constructor that can be used from any package and matches typical expectations.
